text:
maya: heads up - ran into a weird bundler/esm-cjs issue with the JS SDK when building our sampleapp for Vercel Edge (vite). works fine in node dev but the edge bundle throws at runtime.

maya: error seen in prod logs: `TypeError: Redwood.default is not a function` (stack from edge runtime). locally SSR build also fails when I run `vercel dev`.

drew: can you paste minimal repro or config?

maya: yup, quick steps:
```
# package.json
{
  "name": "sampleapp",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "redwood-inference": "0.8.2"
  }
}

# vite.config.ts (relevant bits)
export default defineConfig({
  ssr: { external: [] },
  build: { target: 'es2020' }
})

# import in app code
import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
```

maya: switching the import to `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` makes the runtime error go away but TS complains about default imports in some setups.

sam: can you share a link to the tiny repro repo? also which bundler version? vite 4 / esbuild 0.18?

maya: using vite 4.4 + esbuild 0.19; i pushed a tiny repro: https://github.com/redwood-sample/repro-edge-bundler (private gist in real thread).

alex: sounds like classic default-interop churn between cjs/esm builds. if the SDK publishes only CJS with a `main` and an ESM entry that re-exports, some bundlers won't surface a proper `default` on the ESM build. can we check package.json `exports`/`module` fields in the SDK?

laura: also seeing TS noise: `Module "redwood-inference" has no default export.` quick dev workaround: enable `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` or import `* as` per maya.

ci-bot: CI notice - `sampleapp-edge-build` job failed on matrix node (logs at https://ci/internal/1234).

drew: short-term: update sampleapp templates/docs to recommend `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` for edge + bundlers and call out TS flags. long-term: we should make SDK emitter compatible across bundlers (add explicit default in ESM output).

alex: i can take the long term fix. plan: add a tiny ESM shim that does `import { createClient } from './dist/esm/index.js'; export default createClient; export * from './dist/esm/index.js';` and ensure `exports` points to that. will open an issue + PR.

maya: that shim sounds good. also we should update the sampleapp and the onboarding guide (quickstart) so new users on Vite/Edge aren't blocked.

drew: opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/512 - PR incoming from alex.

alex: PR draft pushed, includes changes to rollup build config and a new `dist/esm/default.js` shim + types re-export. i left a note about adding a test that bundles sampleapp with vite in the CI matrix.

laura: will add a tip in docs about `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` and show the `import * as` workaround in the quickstart until PR lands.

deploy-bot: staging deploy of `docs/quickstart` updated (preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/quickstart).

maya: thanks all - confirmed the `import * as` workaround works for our prod deploy. will watch alex's PR and update the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
